title: Bone of the Forgotten
summary: Ha-Jun arrives at the desolate Incheon limestone quarry, descending into the sunken subterranean ossuary catacombs to locate the Bone of the Forgotten.

panels.shot: abandoned incheon limestone quarry wide shot
panels.action: A colossal crater of jagged white limestone cliffs under heavy storm clouds; rusted cranes loom like skeletons.
panels.prose_en: A colossal crater of jagged white limestone cliffs under heavy storm clouds; rusted cranes loom like skeletons.
panels.prose_hi: Bhari toofani baadalon ke neeche dantedar safed chuna patthar ki chattanon ka ek vishal gaddha; jung lagi sarsen kankal ki tarah dikhai deti han.

panels.shot: van parked near rusted chainlink fence
panels.action: The laundry van halts beside a bent 'DANGER: SINKHOLE COLLAPSE' hazard warning sign.
panels.prose_en: The laundry van halts beside a bent 'DANGER: SINKHOLE COLLAPSE' hazard warning sign.
panels.prose_hi: Kapade dhone ki van ek jhuke hue 'khtare: sinkehol patan' khatre ki chetavani ke sanket ke paas rukti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps onto the chalky limestone mud, wearing a dark hooded windbreaker over his uniform.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps onto the chalky limestone mud, wearing a dark hooded windbreaker over his uniform.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni vardi ke upar gahre rang ka hud wala vindbraker pahankar chakaleti chuna patthar ki mitti par kadam rakhta hai.

panels.action: Kuro circles above through the dense limestone mist, scanning the quarry floor.
panels.prose_en: Kuro circles above through the dense limestone mist, scanning the quarry floor.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ghane chuna patthar ki dhundh ke madhyam se khadan ke farsh ko scan karte hue upar chakkar lagata hai.

panels.shot: gaping sinkhole rift in quarry floor
panels.action: In the lowest depression of the quarry, a 50-foot jagged chasm exhales bone-chilling white mist.
panels.prose_en: In the lowest depression of the quarry, a 50-foot jagged chasm exhales bone-chilling white mist.
panels.prose_hi: Khdan ke sabse nichle avsad men, 50 foot ki dantedar khai haddiyon ko kampa dene wali safed dhundh chodti hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae hands Ha-Jun a heavy military flare gun and three crimson phosphorus cartridges.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Agar niche radio signal cut ho jaye, toh red flare fire karna.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae hands Ha-Jun a heavy military flare gun and three crimson phosphorus cartridges.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ne ha-jun ko ek bhari sainya flair bandook aur teen lal phosphorus kartoos saunpe.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pockets the flares and smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Yahan van mein safe rehna.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar koi Hunter aaye, toh bina soche bhaag jana, samjhe?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pockets the flares and smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Yahan van mein safe rehna.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne palkein jhapkain aur shant kritagyata ke saath muskuraya: 'yahan van mein surakshit rahna.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun dives over the precipice into the white mist, using mana to glide along the sheer rock face.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun dives over the precipice into the white mist, using mana to glide along the sheer rock face.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun chattan ke upar se safed dhundh mein gota lagata hai, man ka upyog karte hue vishal chattan par fisalta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun lands in a three-point stance on cold, petrified white stone tiles 200 feet below ground.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands in a three-point stance on cold, petrified white stone tiles 200 feet below ground.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun jameen se 200 feet neeche thandi, pathrili safed patthar ki tailon par teen-bindu rukh mein utarta hai.

panels.action: Faint cyan phosphorescence emanates from glowing mineral deposits lining the ancient arched limestone vault.
panels.prose_en: Faint cyan phosphorescence emanates from glowing mineral deposits lining the ancient arched limestone vault.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin dhanushakar chuna patthar ki tijori mein chamakte khanij bhandar se halki siyan fosforsence nikalti hai.

panels.shot: ground paved with millions of petrified bones
panels.action: The entire floor is paved not with tiles, but with millions of calcified ancient demonic and human bones.
panels.prose_en: The entire floor is paved not with tiles, but with millions of calcified ancient demonic and human bones.
panels.prose_hi: Pura farsh tiles se nahin, balki lakhon calsified prachin rakshasi aur manav haddiyon se bana hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on broken statue head
panels.action: Kuro alights atop the shattered stone head of a four-armed demon deity.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Tomb of the Million Martyrs. Yeh First Sovereign ki royal army ka burial ground hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro alights atop the shattered stone head of a four-armed demon deity.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek char-sashastra rakshas devta ke toote hue patthar ke sir ke upar baithta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks between colossal pillars carved directly from fused gigantic spinal columns.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Itni ajeeb shanti hai yahan... jaise hazaron roohein so rahi hon.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks between colossal pillars carved directly from fused gigantic spinal columns.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sidhe jude hue vishal reedh ki haddi ke stambhon se bane vishal stambhon ke beech chalta hai.

panels.shot: ring of hollow blood pulsing cold
panels.action: The obsidian ring turns ice-cold, frosting over with white rime as it detects bone marrow resonance.
panels.prose_en: The obsidian ring turns ice-cold, frosting over with white rime as it detects bone marrow resonance.
panels.prose_hi: Asthi majja anunaad ka pata lagane par obsidian ring barf jaisi thandi ho jaati hai, safed chuna se jam jaati hai.

panels.action: The Sovereign Interface flashes with sharp bone-white runes.

dialogue.text:
[QUEST ADVANCE: BASIC SEAL - PART 2]
Locate the Sovereign's Bone.
Warning: The Eternal Guardian slumbers nearby.
Awakening Risk: Extreme.

panels.prose_en: The Sovereign Interface flashes with sharp bone-white runes.
panels.prose_hi: Soweren interface tej haddi-safed runs ke saath chamakta hai.

panels.action: At the apex of a seven-tiered limestone staircase rests a crystalline ossuary altar.
panels.prose_en: At the apex of a seven-tiered limestone staircase rests a crystalline ossuary altar.
panels.prose_hi: Saat-stariy chuna patthar ki sidhi ke sheersh par ek crystaliy asthi-kalsh vedi tiki hui hai.

panels.action: Suspended above the altar: an intricate, 14-inch curved ivory bone relic engraved with glowing violet runes.
panels.prose_en: Suspended above the altar: an intricate, 14-inch curved ivory bone relic engraved with glowing violet runes.
panels.prose_hi: Vedi ke upar nilambit: ek jatil, 14 inch ki ghumavdar hathi daant ki haddi ka avshesh, jo chamakte baingani rang ke dhaagon se ukera gaya hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun ascends the final step, reaching his right hand toward the suspended bone artifact.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ascends the final step, reaching his right hand toward the suspended bone artifact.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun antim charan par chadhta hai, apne dahine haath ko nilambit haddi ki kalakriti ki or badhata hai.

panels.action: The entire cavern violently shudders; bone pillars rattle as dust cascades from the ceiling.
panels.prose_en: The entire cavern violently shudders; bone pillars rattle as dust cascades from the ceiling.
panels.prose_hi: Puri gufa joron se kamp uthti hai; chhat se dhul ke jharne ke roop mein haddi ke khambhe khadkhadane lagte han.

panels.shot: bones on floor swirling in vortex
panels.action: Thousands of calcified bones across the floor begin swirling into a ferocious skeletal cyclone.
panels.prose_en: Thousands of calcified bones across the floor begin swirling into a ferocious skeletal cyclone.
panels.prose_hi: Farsh par hajaron calsified haddiyan ek krur kankal chakravaat mein ghumne lagti han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps backward four meters, landing on guard with hands up as wind lashes his coat.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps backward four meters, landing on guard with hands up as wind lashes his coat.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun char meter peeche ki or chhalang lagata hai, jaise hi hawa uske coat par prahar karti hai, wah haath upar karke pehra deta hai.

panels.action: Kuro takes to the air, wings flaring with violet sparks: 'Guardian jaag chuka hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: SKELETAL CENTURION! Apni talwar nikaalo, Ha-Jun!

panels.prose_en: Kuro takes to the air, wings flaring with violet sparks: 'Guardian jaag chuka hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro hawa mein udta hai, uske pankh baingani rang ki chingari se chamak rahe han: 'garjian jaag chuka hai!'.

panels.action: From the bone cyclone rises a colossal 15-foot Skeletal Centurion clad in ancient oxidized bronze armor.
panels.prose_en: From the bone cyclone rises a colossal 15-foot Skeletal Centurion clad in ancient oxidized bronze armor.
panels.prose_hi: Asthi chakravaat se prachin oxikrit kansya kavach mein lipta ek vishal 15 foot ka kankal centurion nikalta hai.

panels.action: Two blazing azure soul-flames ignite inside the Centurion's massive horned skull.
panels.prose_en: Two blazing azure soul-flames ignite inside the Centurion's massive horned skull.
panels.prose_hi: Senturian ki vishal seeng wali khopdi ke andar do dhadhakti neela aatma-lapten prajvalit hoti han.

panels.action: With a terrifying scrape, the giant pulls an eight-foot serrated bone broadsword from its own spinal column.
panels.prose_en: With a terrifying scrape, the giant pulls an eight-foot serrated bone broadsword from its own spinal column.
panels.prose_hi: Ek bhayanak kharonch ke sath, vishal apni hi reedh ki haddi se aath foot ki daatedar haddi wali chaudi talwar ko khinch leta hai.

panels.action: A voice like grinding boulders booms through the air, vibrating Ha-Jun's eardrums.

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: KAUN HAI WOH NAADAN JO SOVEREIGN KI BONE KO CHHUNE AAYA HAI?!

panels.prose_en: A voice like grinding boulders booms through the air, vibrating Ha-Jun's eardrums.
panels.prose_hi: Pattharon ko pisne jaisi awaaz hawa mein gunjati hai, ha-jun ke kanon ko kampan karti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes upward at the towering juggernaut, his heart hammering against his ribs.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pandraah foot lamba... Iska ek strike mujhe pahaad ki tarah crush kar dega!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes upward at the towering juggernaut, his heart hammering against his ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun oonche rath ko upar ki or dekhta hai, uska dil uski pasliyon par jor se dhadak raha hai.

panels.shot: centurion locking gaze on hajun ring
panels.action: The Centurion's azure eye-flames flicker as he notices the obsidian Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger.
panels.prose_en: The Centurion's azure eye-flames flicker as he notices the obsidian Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger.
panels.prose_hi: Jab centurion ne ha-jun ki ungli par obsidian ring off hollow blood ko dekha to uski neeli aankhen chamak uthin.

panels.action: The giant raises his bone broadsword high overhead with both skeletal hands, aura blasting outward.

dialogue.speaker: centurion
dialogue.text: PROVE THY BLOOD, MORTAL WHELP! OR BECOME DUST UPON THIS FLOOR!

panels.prose_en: The giant raises his bone broadsword high overhead with both skeletal hands, aura blasting outward.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal apne donon kankaliy hathon se apni haddi ki chaudi talwar ko upar ki or uthata hai, uski aabha bahar ki or chamakti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning blood blade with furious gaze
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws his palm across his ring; The Sanguine Fang crystallizes in blazing crimson: 'Try me.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aao phir... Dekhte hain tumhari talwar tez hai ya mera khoon!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws his palm across his ring; The Sanguine Fang crystallizes in blazing crimson: 'Try me.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni anguthi par apni hatheli khinchta hai; senguin fang dhadhakte lal rang mein cristlikrit hota hai: 'mujhe azmaen.'
